about: The numbers every pcbv change has to beat: spinny-survey baseline grades the survey below (169 pictures of an OreSat battery card, github.com/oresat/oresat-batteries oresat-battery-card at 031b458, under a LumenPnP's top camera on 2026-11-14, 8 by 7.5 mm apart over the board and a margin) with each case's pcbv options against the truth here, and fails when a case has fewer right locks, more wrong ones, or a right rms higher by more than rms_slack_mm. The pictures stay in var/surveys on the machine that took them.

truth.about: head = R(turn_deg) (x, -y) + shift for a KiCad board point (x, y), the head's place over it in the LumenPnP's X and Y, mm: the robust fit of the scale case's 52 right locks

scale.about: pcbv told the scale within a fifth either way of the camera's 0.0161 mm a pixel
scale.pcbv: pcb-vision bf6c52b (the session's build gave the same)

noscale.about: no scale given: pcbv tries its whole range, then its scale windows
noscale.pcbv: pcb-vision bf6c52b (the session's build gave the same)
